title: Synthetic Child-Adult Interactions Are Not Developmentally Plausible
abstract: arXiv:2610.35029v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synthetic data has become a common resource for training language models, and this trend has spilled over into research on developmentally plausible language modeling. However, it remains unclear whether LM-generated child-adult interactions actually resemble natural ones. We compare the synthetic TinyDialogues dataset to natural dialogue across a broad range of linguistic measures. While synthetic data matches natural data on the lexical level, it drastically underestimates the messy, fragmented nature of spoken interaction. To mitigate this, we propose instruction-tuning with data created from real dialogues, and show in a pilot study that a small model approximates the statistical tendencies of natural data after moderate parameter-efficient fine-tuning.

translated_title: 合成的儿童-成人互动对话不符合发展规律
translated_abstract: 合成数据已成为训练语言模型的常用资源，这一趋势也蔓延到了发展合理性语言建模的研究领域。然而，语言模型生成的儿童-成人互动对话是否真的与自然对话相似，目前仍不清楚。我们在广泛的语言学指标上，将合成的 TinyDialogues 数据集与自然对话进行了比较。虽然合成数据在词汇层面与自然数据相匹配，但它极大地低估了口语互动混乱、碎片化的特性。为了缓解这一问题，我们提出使用由真实对话创建的数据进行指令微调，并在一项初步研究中表明，一个小型模型在经过适度的参数高效微调后，能够接近自然数据的统计特征。
tldr: 该论文发现合成的儿童-成人对话数据虽在词汇层面接近自然对话，却严重低估了口语互动的混乱与碎片化特性，并提出用真实对话数据进行指令微调，使小模型经过适度参数高效微调后即可逼近自然数据的统计特征。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that synthetic child-adult dialogues match natural data at the lexical level but drastically underestimate the messy, fragmented nature of spoken interaction, and demonstrates that instruction-tuning on data derived from real dialogues allows a small model to approximate the statistical tendencies of natural data after moderate parameter-efficient fine-tuning.
